title: basicly catalog eval case
description: Tier-2 routing evidence for one catalog entry, colocated with its source so a reviewer sees the entry and its evidence in one diff. The invocation axis is NOT repeated here: it is declared once on skill.yaml, and a second copy could only ever drift from it.

schema_version.description: Source-format version; bump only when the loader contract changes.

positive.description: Realistic prompts this entry must own. Paraphrase how a user actually talks; copying the description into the prompt games the eval and measures nothing.

top_k.description: Rank the owner must reach. Defaults to 3; an entry's signature ask declares 1.

negative.description: Prompts owned by a DIFFERENT entry. The assertion is that the named owner outranks this entry - not merely that this entry fails to rank first, which passes vacuously when the prompt matches nothing.

owner.description: Slug of the model-invoked entry that should answer this prompt.
